rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn: Soul Rend silences for 5 s and gives True Strike against the silenced target; the passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. Orchid is in his build (34%, ~18 min). High-rank Dragon Knights against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: Bloodthorn 22% of 102 games (14% otherwise), won 65% against 42%.

rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn is built from Orchid Malevolence and keeps its 5 s silence (Soul Rend), with True Strike against the silenced target: with an escape hero and an evasion hero together, one item answers both.

rules.name: Orchid Malevolence
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Orchid Malevolence: Soul Burn silences for 5 s (900 range, 18 s cooldown), so Blink, Ball Lightning or Phase Shift cannot be cast. High-rank Dragon Knights against escape heroes: Orchid 43% of 288 games (22% otherwise), Bloodthorn 24% (9%), won 59% against 47% with Bloodthorn.

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 25:00 18500 (11 games, 81.8%), 30:00 19500 (32 games, 81.2%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.
